title: Granite-4.0-H-Tiny decode frontier: area vs tokens/s
subtitle: P7.6 fixture for the frontier explorer, matching the contract P7.4/P7.5 (builder E3) emit. Decode only (D25); no safety margins (D28).
decode_only: Every point is a decode design point in D29's FILLED PIPELINE: staggered streams, one token out per beat, local batch 1, D = the stage count (10 here, one stage per analog chiplet). Prefill is out of P7 (D25), the streams arrive already prefilled, and no prefill figure appears here.
provisioning_stance: No point carries a safety margin, a derate or a guard band: D28 makes the frontier itself the statement of how close a point runs. The loader refuses any such field by name.

provenance.author: P7.6 hand fixture, REGROUNDED by P7.8 (D32) and corrected by P7.9. The eight sweep points are the REAL candidate rows of docs/qif/dse/granite_lanes_banks/dse_report.json; the ninth is the shipped Granite atlas run. The shared-digital AREA term used to be the one invented field in this document; D32 composes it from the measured synthesis library, so nothing here is invented any more. The shared-digital UTILIZATION is still the field no producer emits per candidate, and it still carries its mark.
grounded: throughput.tokens_per_s and throughput.decode_step_s of all nine points are measured off each candidate's own timeline
area.terms.analog_mm2 is the P3.6 enumerated_macro_silicon accounting
area.terms.shared_digital_mm2 is the D32 COMPOSED chiplet area: unit counts of measured 22nm synthesis blocks x each block's measured area, times the chiplet count the mapping placed

area.terms.macro_pool_mm2 is the D32 COMPOSED per-macro pool area on every enumerated macro slot - the third silicon term, added by P7.9; area.total_mm2 now equals the source report's own total_silicon_mm2 on every swept point
packing.waste_pct is D27's CELL census of the reference mapping (P7.9; it was the smaller column census before)
utilization analog_macro is derived from the reference run's MEASURED macro duty cycle and each point's MEASURED beat
the knee law R + C / lanes is fitted to the 4 measured beats and reproduces all of them to within 3e-05 relative (a fit, not an identity - see knee.basis)
provenance.note: The x axis is REAL and now carries all THREE silicon terms. Wave D's front collapsed because the shared digital card declared no area_mm2; D32 replaced that placeholder with a composition of measured synthesis blocks, and P7.9 added the per-macro pool term the document was missing, so area.total_mm2 agrees with the source sweep's own total_silicon_mm2 point for point. What is still absent is the shared-digital OCCUPANCY per candidate, which draws as the unknown hatch.

x.label: total silicon
x.basis: the machine's three silicon terms, all named per point: enumerated analog macro slots x macro footprint + shared digital chiplets + per-macro digital pools. The analog term is the SLOTS the machine has, not the global cell floor (a lower bound the packer cannot reach once the layers are split across chips).

device_classes.label: analog macro slots

knobs.label: shared-chiplet vector lanes

knobs.basis: constant at 10 over this sweep: no axis here moves it, which is half the reason the front is nearly vertical

throughput.basis: measured at the decode terminal off this candidate's OWN timeline (ADJ-6), fws_qif_dse mapped path.

utilization.basis: analog active time per macro per BEAT 8.224853424291288e-08 s (the reference run's measured macros[].duty_cycle x its measured beat) divided by THIS point's beat. atlas.basis: the shipped P3.6/P4 artifact of this exact design point

knee.basis: the 4 measured BEATS at bank_depth 1 fit beat(lanes) = R + C / lanes to within 3.3e-05 relative - a FIT, not an identity: under D29 the beat is a MAX over the stages, so a reciprocal-in-lanes law describes it closely and does not define it (under the retired lockstep regime the same law was exact to 1e-13, because the step WAS the scan chain) - with residual R = 3.746985827911986e-05 s and C = 0.006227151879699244 s x lanes. The knee is the smallest swept width at which the digital term C / lanes has dropped BELOW the residual no vector-lane count moves: at 512 lanes the term is 0.325 x R. WAVE F (D32, P7.8): the x axis is now REAL - the shared digital chiplet's area is COMPOSED from the measured 22nm synthesis library, so a wider engine costs real silicon and the front is a SPREAD rather than the collapsed point Wave D reported. Across the swept widths 8x the lanes buys 1.273x the throughput for 101.406 mm2 more silicon, and every doubling past the knee pays area for a term that was never binding.
knee.caveat: the residual is NOT the analog m-pass time: analog activity is 8.224853424291288e-08 s per macro per beat, orders below R. What R actually contains is the part of the beat no vector-lane count moves, and decomposing it per device class is P7.4's job, not this fixture's. Note also that none of the swept widths is the width D31 would DERIVE for this machine: every sweep point declares its lanes, which under D31 is an override that rides a disclosure, and the sweep is kept as P7.4's deliverable rather than silently retired here.

relaxations.value: 10 chiplets x the composed per-chiplet area (D32, 22nm)
relaxations.reason: The shared-digital area term is no longer a placeholder: it is a COMPOSITION of blocks a synthesis run measured (GEMMINI_SYS_ARRAY, FP_ADD/FP_MULT/FP_COMP/BF16_EXP/BF16_RECIP/M_REG/TRANSPOSER), counted by this repo's own laws. What it is NOT is a measurement of a whole chiplet: the activation SRAM, the interconnect and the control logic have no block in the library and are not composed, so this term is a LOWER BOUND and the x axis is optimistic by whatever they would have cost (D28 forbids padding it, D21 requires saying so).

relaxations.value: no value at any of the 9 points
relaxations.reason: D28 requires per-device utilization at every point and no producer emits it for the digital class. It draws as the unknown hatch. This is the field the frontier explorer most needs from P7.4.

relaxations.value: 48.1339% of committed CELLS, on one mapping, carried on every row
relaxations.reason: P7.9 CORRECTION. This row used to carry the COLUMN census (28.1960%) and a note saying D27's cell census does not exist yet. It does: cim_timing.dense_pack emits it and P7.2 landed it in the same plan, and for this reference mapping it is 48.1339% — nearly twice the column figure, because a column census misses the row remainder of every tile whose K is below the card's rows. What is still a relaxation is the SCOPE: this is one mapping's census repeated on every row, not a per-point measurement. The per-point cell census is emitted by the frontier curves under docs/qif/dse/*_frontier.

it is the shipped Granite atlas run, carried here because it is the only point with a placement document to click through to. It shares the sweep's analog inventory; its bank_depth is the card's own 4 and its engine is not a swept width at all — D31 DERIVES 220 lanes from its own beat, which is why it carries less digital silicon than any declared-width point on the picture and is the cheapest point on the front. P7.9 CORRECTION: this row previously labelled it 'vector_lanes 1024' and read its bank_depth off 5610 placed tiles, both pre-D30/D31 numbers — it places 5544 tiles and declares no engine width.

relaxations.value: 3 of 256 steps lowered at every point
relaxations.reason: ADJ-6: the DAG grows linearly in decode length, so each candidate lowers a bounded window and the rest is an extrapolation the consumer declares.

relaxations.value: vector_lanes 512-4096, declared-count, on all eight in_sweep points
relaxations.reason: D31 retires vector_lanes as a design point: one beat admits exactly one legal width, and a spread produced by declaring several is an OVERRIDE sweep, not a D31-conformant frontier. The eight points are kept because they are the frozen Wave-D demo sweep and its artifact is regenerate-gated, and because the picture they draw — 8x the lanes buys under 2x the throughput — is the finding that motivated the retirement. The D31-legal curves, whose width is DERIVED at every point, are docs/qif/dse/granite_4_0_h_tiny_frontier and .../qwen3_5_4b_frontier.
